changeSet.comment: RSDEV-1708: ELN form fields gain a field key (a lowercase UUID copied with the field) and an optional display rule (JSON) that shows the field only when another field has a given value

changeSet.author: tchoi-rs
changeSet.comment: RSDEV-1708: give every existing ELN form field a key, a lowercase UUID version 7 generated in Java, so that any field can be picked as a rule source or target

changeSet.author: tchoi-rs
changeSet.comment: RSDEV-1708: the backfill gave the unsaved draft copy of a published form's field (FieldForm.tempFieldForm_id) a key of its own; give it its original's key, as a draft made after the upgrade has, so that an API edit echoing the form's keys is accepted. Updates nothing when every draft copy already has its original's key.
changeSet.sql: update FieldForm draft join FieldForm original on original.tempFieldForm_id = draft.id set draft.fieldKey = original.fieldKey where original.fieldKey is not null and not (draft.fieldKey <=> original.fieldKey);
